Ling-3.0-flash-Fin is a finance-enhanced MoE model built on Ling-3.0-flash, with 124 billion total parameters and approximately 5.1 billion activated parameters. Designed for real-world investment workflows, it is optimized for complex multi-step tasks and long-horizon planning and execution. With a relatively small active parameter footprint, it delivers competitive financial performance while maintaining strong general capabilities in reasoning, coding, and mathematics.
